variation: Right-arm neutral-grip dumbbell row; left hand and left knee supported on bench, right foot on floor.
camera: Fixed side three-quarter from right working side; head left, hips right; view working lat and grip.
equipment: One modest round black dumbbell, flat dark bench.
anchors: Left hand and left knee on bench
Head, torso and pelvis with no twist
invariants: Dumbbell diameter, head thickness and handle length

frames.label: Set up
frames.cue: Support one hand and same-side knee; let the weight hang.
frames.state: Working arm extended, neutral grip; spine long and torso nearly level.

frames.label: Begin row
frames.cue: Draw the elbow back towards your hip.
frames.state: Small shoulder extension and elbow flexion; dumbbell begins rising.

frames.label: Continue row
frames.cue: Keep your torso still as the elbow passes your ribs.
frames.state: Mid row, elbow back, shoulder not shrugged.

frames.label: Top row
frames.cue: Bring the weight beside your hip without twisting.
frames.state: Upper arm near torso line, elbow flexed, weight close to lateral lower ribs/hip.

frames.label: Controlled lower
frames.cue: Lower slowly while keeping your back still.

frames.label: Finish lowering
frames.cue: Extend the arm back towards the starting stretch.
frames.state: Same as frame2, descending; loop to full hang.
